title: Object Storage: outage claim — source invoice basis
content:
For Object Storage outage claim, locate the source charge from initial source reference on the authorization selected by the storage holding customer request reference, and read net amount of that exact posted storage charge.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage claim in this situation? Locate the source charge from initial source reference on the authorization selected by the storage holding customer request reference, and read net amount of that exact posted storage charge.
